data.credibility: Management shows mixed reliability. They successfully delivered early LCA targets and exceeded order book expectations, but frequently let revenue growth and margin guidance slip, while quietly dropping several older commitments like manpower costs and specific cash balance targets.

lines.line: Maintained EBITDA margin above target, reaching 31% in Q4 FY23 versus 26-27% guided.
ROH revenue growth target of 8-9% was dropped after initial delays and lowered estimates.
Cash balance target of Rs. 15,000 crore for March 2023 was dropped without updates.
Delivered 3 units of the 83 Mark1A LCA program in the scheduled first year.
Double-digit revenue growth target of 10% from FY25 has been slipping following lowered expectations.
Revenue growth stabilization around 14-15% after FY25 is currently slipping after lowered forecasts.
Estimated order value of INR 48,000 crores in 6 to 10 months was dropped.
Manpower cost reduction target to 16% of revenue was dropped after initial guidance.
Total CAPEX estimate of 14,000 to 15,000 crores for the next 5 years remains on track.
Outstanding order book reached 1,89,300 crores by March 2025, beating the 1,20,000 crore target.
Nashik third line for LCA became operational after initial delays, fulfilling the goal.
Operating profit margin of 27% is slipping, currently at 24.9% in FY27 so far.
Missed the target to deliver 12 LCA engines in the calendar year up to December.
Tejas Mark-2 prototype flight is slipping after being delayed from Q1 FY27.
GE F414 engine deal conclusion is slipping beyond FY26 without mention.
Target to reach capacity of 30 LCA aircraft per annum in two years remains on track.
Pending investment target of INR 12,000 crores in manufacturing infrastructure by 2030.
Pending target to receive INR 90,000 crores in orders during the next 2 years.
Pending target to roll out Tejas Mark II prototype by March of current financial year.

bull: Outstanding order book reached 1,89,300 crores by March 2025, significantly outperforming initial targets.
EBITDA margin widened from 23.5% in FY21 to 29.6% in FY26, supporting strong profitability.
The company is almost debt-free with borrowings of just ₹10 cr against a net worth of ₹43,999 cr.
bear: Working-capital days have stretched significantly from 141 to 301 over the past five years.
Export share remains extremely low at just 1.58% of total turnover in FY25-26.
Operating profit to revenue has slipped to 24.9% in FY27 so far, below the 27% guided target.
